controls.name: band-limited input identity
controls.role: Task-matched damaged-input baseline: the 3.5 kHz low-passed signal scored 17.40 dB SI-SDR and 0.9868 STOI in the local pilot.

controls.name: low-band spectrum-copy extension (negative control)
controls.role: Deterministic classical proxy that copies low-band spectrum into the missing high band; it fell to 14.39 dB SI-SDR and 0.9725 STOI on all 12 clips and is rejected.

controls.name: full-band clean reference
controls.role: Upper-bound paired target for BWE scoring; it is the clean waveform, not a generated or band-limited estimate.

controls.name: known zero-phase 3.5 kHz cutoff
controls.role: Frozen corruption metadata: 2.56% of high-band energy is removed; the cutoff is supplied to the methods and blind cutoff estimation is untested.

controls.name: resampling / rate conversion alone
controls.role: Adjacent negative demonstration: changing sample rate or bandwidth does not infer missing high frequencies and is never counted as BWE.

controls.name: nonfinite input adverse case
controls.role: NaN/Inf input is rejected with no serialized output and cannot count as a pass.

controls.name: missing, invalid, malformed and empty input
controls.role: Empty audio, wrong rate/channel, truncated container and missing bytes are explicit rejections; no fallback is written.

controls.name: normative pilot BWE baselines
controls.role: Defines degrade_bandlimit (zero-phase 8th-order Butterworth at 3.5 kHz) and bwe_spectral_copy (tiled low-band copy with edge taper); read as context, not executed here.
